requirement_summary: 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS9.3 Delegation and SS9.6 Cyclic Delegation: 'Agent A가 Agent B에 일을 위임해도 B가 A보다 넓은 권한을 획득하지 않는다. delegation chain, purpose, TTL, subject scope를 보존한다... A->B->C->A delegation loop, 책임 떠넘기기, 무한 handoff를 탐지한다. final authority는 명시된 principal/contract에서만 온다.'
subject: SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.delegationChainCheck via assurance.delegation.chain-check
coverage_notes: Eighth closure of Batch 5's disclosed broader-scope gap. Complements the pre-existing DelegationLedger (which enforces one grant's delegator-must-hold-the-role invariant in isolation) by validating an entire multi-hop chain of edges at once. cycle_detected is a real directed-graph DFS (visited + in-progress recursion-stack, the standard algorithm) over the submitted edges -- delegationCycleSearch finds any agent reachable from itself however many hops away and returns the actual repeating path, not a caller-declared flag. delegationChainCheckDetectsAThreeNodeCycle is the direct test of the named A->B->C->A loop case; delegationChainCheckDoesNotFalselyFlagABranchingNonCyclicGraph proves a fan-out delegation graph (A delegates to both B and C independently) is never mistaken for a cycle. authority_expansion_detected is checked per edge -- delegated_authority_scope must be a real subset of that edge's own from_agent_authority_scope -- closing 'B가 A보다 넓은 권한을 획득하지 않는다' for every hop in the chain, not just the first; delegationChainCheckAggregatesBothCycleAndExpansionViolationsTogether proves both violation classes are reported together rather than the cycle short-circuiting the expansion check.
open_gap: Operates on a caller-supplied edge list; there is no live multi-agent delegation runtime in this codebase that actually emits these edges from real agent-to-agent handoffs (same disclosed 'caller-supplied representation, not live system integration' pattern as every other Batch 5 broader-scope closure this session). purpose/TTL/subject-scope preservation named in SS9.3's text beyond authority-scope containment is not modeled by this schema -- only the authority-non-expansion and cycle-freedom sub-rules are covered. 1 of the 9 originally-named broader-scope areas remains open: RAG Assurance (SS6).
